999008199.text: わぁ～……っ！

これが船旅……！　これが島の外……！
はぁ～！　晴れやか！　すがすがしい気分！

localizations.en: This is a boat trip! This is the world beyond our island! Ahh! This is so refreshing! I feel so free!

999008199.text:
ねえ見てベップ！　アタシたちの島がもうあんなに
小さく！　いいね～、楽しいねえ～！

localizations.en: Look, Bepp! Our island is already so tiny! This is great! It's so much fun!

999008199.text: ええ、そんな姉様を見ているだけで楽しいわ

localizations.en: Just watching you enjoy yourself is entertaining enough for me.

999008199.text: なんだ、もしかして嬢ちゃん、船に乗るのは初めてか？

localizations.en: Wait, is this your first time on a ship, missy?

999008199.text: はい。今までず～っと島の中で暮らしてましたから

localizations.en: Yes! I've lived on the island my whole life.

999008199.text:
そうか。なら、存分に楽しんでくれ。
船酔いには気を付けてな

localizations.en: I see. Well, enjoy it to the fullest. Just watch the seasickness.

999008199.text:
……いやぁ、分かるなあ。
島から外に出た時の解放感がね～

localizations.en: I totally get it. That feeling of freedom when you first leave your home island is amazing!

999008199.text:
もう……。遊びに行くわけじゃないんだから
あんまりはしゃいじゃダメよ？

localizations.en: Now, now... This isn't a pleasure cruise, so don't get too carried away, okay?

999008199.text:
船だって私たちのものじゃなくて、
出していただいているものなんだから

localizations.en: This isn't even our ship—they're letting us use it.

999008199.text: 気にすることはねえ。仲間なんだからよ

localizations.en: Don't worry about it. We're all comrades here.

999008199.text: うす！　ありがとうございます！

localizations.en: Yes sir! Thank you so much!

999008199.text:
そういえば、今回は行かないけど、
女の人しか入れない島とかもあるんですって

localizations.en: Oh, speaking of which, we're not visiting at this time, but I heard there are islands that only women can enter.

999008199.text:
なんだって？
それって俺が入ったらどうなっちまうんだ？

localizations.en: What? What would happen if I tried to go there?

999008199.text:
まず上陸させてもらえないんじゃ？
男と分かった瞬間追い返されそうっす

localizations.en: They probably wouldn't let you land in the first place. The moment they realized you were a man, you'd get turned away.

999008199.text:
女の人しか入れない島があるなら、
その反対もあったりするのかなあ？

localizations.en: If there are islands only women can enter, I wonder if there are any that only men can enter too?

999008199.text:
そっちもあるみたいっすよ。
ホント、色んな島があるもんよ

localizations.en: Those exist too, apparently. There really are all kinds of islands out there.

999008199.text: どうした？　何か見えたか？

……ううん。なんとなく視線を感じるって言うか。
見張られてる感じがするのよね

localizations.en: No... I just feel like someone's watching us. Like we're being monitored.

999008199.text:
もしかして、イェルカたちが……
でも、こんな海の上まで追いかけてこないか

localizations.en: Could it be Jelka and her people? But they wouldn't follow us all the way out here on the ocean, would they?

999008199.text:
どうかしらね。あいつらならやりかねないとも
思っちゃうけど

localizations.en: Hard to say. I wouldn't put it past them though.

999008199.text: こういう時、ハイディがいれば……

localizations.en: It's times like these that I really wish Heidi were here...

999008199.text: ハイディ？　ヴァレリアの知り合い？

うん。私の相棒なの。
今は事情があって別行動してるけど

localizations.en: Yeah. She's my partner. We're traveling separately right now due to some circumstances.

999008199.text:
へえ～。ヴァレリアの相棒っていうくらいだから、
相当な手練れと見た！

localizations.en: Ooh! If she's your partner, she must be quite the brawler!

999008199.text:
まあ、私に比べたら戦うのはちょっと苦手だけど。
手先が器用で、偵察とかも得意なのよ

localizations.en: Well, she's not as good at fighting as I am. But she's skilled with her hands, and she's great at reconnaissance.

999008199.text: ハイディ、元気にしてるかしら……
